listening_tls_port.description: TLS port for encrypted TURN traffic.

relay_ip.description: Primary public IP address assigned to this server for relay binding.

additional_relay_ips.description: Additional relay IPs (for multi-homed or high-availability setups).

items.description: Public IP address for relay binding.

external_ip.description: Public IP as seen by clients (used in NAT scenarios). Must match relay_ip in many cases.

additional_external_ips.description: Additional external IPs for redundancy or load balancing.

items.description: Public IP address visible to clients.

use_auth_secret.description: Enable time-limited credentials using auth-secret (preferred for web apps).

auth_secret.description: Secret key for auth-secret (must be kept secure; used with TURN REST API).

users.description: List of static long-term credentials (username/password pairs).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS server certificate (PEM format).

tls_private_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format).

tls_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying client certificates (optional).

tls_cipher_list.description: Allowed TLS cipher suites (OpenSSL cipher string).

allow_peer_ip.description: Comma-separated list of IPs allowed to connect as peers (for testing/debugging).

deny_peer_ip.description: Comma-separated list of IPs explicitly denied peer access.

min_port.description: Lowest UDP port number for relay allocation.

max_port.description: Highest UDP port number for relay allocation.

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0–5); higher = more logging. Use 5 for troubleshooting.

pidfile_path.description: Path to PID file for the daemon.

proc_user.description: Unprivileged user to run the server as (security best practice).

stun_only.description: Run as STUN-only server (disable TURN relay functionality).

enable_rest_api.description: Enable the REST API for dynamic credential management (requires --rest-api at startup).
